concerns.text: The plan fits ordinary least‑squares (OLS) models (T020‑T022) and validates them via F‑test improvement (T023) and predictor‑level significance after a global Benjamini‑Hochberg correction (T025‑T026). However, the data are spatially referenced (latitude/longitude, elevation) and likely exhibit spatial autocorrelation, violating the OLS independence assumption. No diagnostic (e.g., Moran’s I) or spatial modelling alternative (e.g., spatial lag/error models, mixed‑effects with spatial random effects) is included, which can lead to inflated type‑I error rates and misleading significance claims.
